consistency.basis: spread across all games of a quantity every deck has — not of kill turn, which is censored by how often a deck kills at all

response.basis: card_roles.json over the 99 — CAPACITY, not performance

limits: No pod, no opponent and no interaction: this measures a DECK, not a table. It is not a win rate and must not be shown beside one.
Nothing blocks and nothing removes, so every speed figure is a ceiling — the fastest this deck goes when unopposed.
`response` is CAPACITY from card_roles.json, not a measured response: a model with no table cannot observe one.
Uniform model flags override each deck's own declaration, which is what makes decks comparable and also what makes these figures differ from the deck's own tracked goldfish_metrics.json.
